changelog:
**Major overhaul focusing on figure integrity, slide logic, and render-based QA for journal club decks.**

- Replaced previous implementation with a stricter, figure-first workflow that prioritizes main/support evidence pairing and visual polish.
- Dropped legacy scripting, templates, and color-scheme files in favor of detailed references and checklists on figure handling, QA, and mapping results to arguments.
- Changed the skill description and requirements to emphasize preservation of paper logic, audience-facing design, and robust checkpointing through render-based quality checks.
- Added new reference materials for deep figure integrity, mapping/crop notes, multi-paper synthesis, and QA for PPTX output.
- Removed previous sample scripts and generic install/readme documentation to reduce confusion and enforce the new process standards.
